summary: WebThings Gateway is an open-source platform designed to implement the Web of Things, helping you connect and control smart home devices locally. It provides a centralised interface and supporting framework to manage various internet-connected hardware through web standards. The project is built using Node.js and distributed under the MPL-2.0 licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you want to experiment with standards-based smart home control and prefer open-source web technologies for local IoT management.
watchOut: The project exhibits low overall maintenance health, meaning you may encounter unpatched bugs, security issues, or a lack of active community support.
deployNotes: As a Node.js application, it typically requires persistent storage for configuration data and a reverse proxy to handle secure TLS connections over HTTPS.
